galatians.3.p1.b2.text: Who has bewitched you? Before your very eyes Jesus Christ was clearly portrayed as crucified.

galatians.3.p1.b3.text: Did you receive the Spirit by works of the law, or by hearing with faith?

galatians.3.p2.b1.text: After starting in the Spirit, are you now finishing in the flesh?

galatians.3.p2.b2.text: Have you suffered so much for nothing, if it really was for nothing?

galatians.3.p2.b3.text: Does God lavish His Spirit on you and work miracles among you because you practice the law, or because you hear and believe?

galatians.3.p3.b1.text: Abraham believed God, and it was credited to him as righteousness.

galatians.3.p3.b2.text: Understand, then, that those who have faith are sons of Abraham.

galatians.3.p3.b3.text: All nations will be blessed through you.

galatians.3.p4.b1.text: All who rely on works of the law are under a curse.

galatians.3.p4.b2.text: The righteous will live by faith.

galatians.3.p4.b3.text: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us.

galatians.3.p4.b4.text: He redeemed us in order that the blessing promised to Abraham would come to the Gentiles in Christ Jesus,

galatians.3.p5.b1.text: Brothers, let me put this in human terms.

galatians.3.p5.b2.text: Even a human covenant, once it is ratified, cannot be canceled or amended.

galatians.3.p5.b3.text: “and to your seed,” meaning One, who is Christ.

galatians.3.p5.b4.text: God freely granted it to Abraham through a promise.

galatians.3.p6.b1.text: Why then was the law given? It was added because of transgressions,

galatians.3.p6.b2.text: Is the law, then, opposed to the promises of God? Certainly not!

galatians.3.p6.b3.text: But the Scripture pronounces all things confined by sin, so that by faith in Jesus Christ the promise might be given to those who believe.

galatians.3.p7.b1.text: … we were held in custody under the law, locked up until faith should be revealed.

galatians.3.p7.b2.text: So the law became our guardian to lead us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

galatians.3.p7.b3.text: … we are no longer under a guardian.

galatians.3.p8.b1.text: You are all sons of God through faith in Christ Jesus.

galatians.3.p8.b2.text: There is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male nor female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

galatians.3.p8.b3.text: And if you belong to Christ, then you are Abraham’s seed and heirs according to the promise.
